div.head: Ine 25.1
div.ab: Gif man forstolen feoh æt ceapmen befó, ⁊ hit næbbe beforan godum witum geceapod, gecyðe hit be wite, ðæt he na gewita ne gestala nære, oððe gilde to wite VI ⁊ XXX scll'.
Gif ðiefefioh mon æt ciepan befo, ⁊ he hit næbbe beforan godum weotum geceapod, gecyðe hit be wite, þæt he ne gewita ne gestala nære, oððe gielde to wite VI ⁊ XXX scill.

Si quid furtiuum intercietur super mercatorem, et hoc coram bonis testibus non emerit, iuret secundum witam, quod nec furti conscius uel coadiutor fuerit in eo, uel emendet XXXVI sol. wite (id est forisfacture uel emendationis).
Gif ðiefefioh mon æt ciepan befo, ⁊ hit næbbe beforan godum weotum geceapod, gecyðe hit be wite, þæt he ne gewita ne gestala nære, oððe gielde to wite VI ⁊ XXX sciƚƚ.

If stolen property is found in the merchant’s possession, and he has not bought it in the presence of good witnesses, let him declare [with an oath] in the amount of the fine that he was neither accessory nor thief, or let him give as fine 6 and 30 shillings.

If stolen property in the hands of a trader is attached, and he has not bought it in the presence of trustworthy witnesses, he shall declare with an oath equal to the penalty [involved] that he has been neither an accessory nor an accomplice [to the theft], or pay a fine of 36 shillings.

If stolen property in a trader’s possession is attached, and he has not bought it before good witnesses, he is to declare by [an oath of the amount of] the fine, that he was neither accessory nor confederate to the theft; otherwise he is to pay 36 shillings as a fine.

Wenn man Diebstahlsgut beim Kaufmann im Anefang fasst, und dieser es nicht vor guten Zeugen gekauft hat, so beschwöre er [durch Eid] in Höhe des Strafgeldes, dass er weder Mitwisser noch Stehler war, oder er zahle 36 Schill. zur Strafe.

If stolen goods are attached at a merchant’s, and he did not buy them before good witnesses, let him swear [an oath] to the amount of the fine that he was neither an accessory nor a thief, or let him pay 36 shillings as a fine.

note.label: compare
note.quote: Compare to Swerian §3 (ne gewita ne gewyrhta).

note.label: cf.
note.quote: He thus needs thirty-six oath supporters. Cf. Hloþhere and Eadric §11–11.3 [L16–16.3].
